allow: PowerShell(Get-Command node, npm, docker, ngrok -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

PowerShell($tools = 'node','npm','docker','ngrok'; foreach \($t in $tools\) { $cmd = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { Write-Output "$t : FOUND at $\($cmd.Source\)" } else { Write-Output "$t : NOT FOUND" } })

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($conn\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "Port 3000 owned by: PID=$\($conn.OwningProcess\) Name=$\($proc.ProcessName\) Path=$\($proc.Path\)" } else { Write-Output "Nothing listening on port 3000" })
